title: Ewing PMC retrieval query + recall/precision against a seed set
context: The corpus needs a reproducible PMC OA retrieval query for Ewing sarcoma literature, measured against a known seed set so recall/precision are honest. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Retrieval is limited to the PMC OA Subset; non-OA hits are reduced to bibliographic metadata downstream.
objective: Define and evaluate the Ewing sarcoma PMC OA retrieval query, reporting recall/precision against a documented seed set.
acceptanceCriteria: PMC OA retrieval query for Ewing sarcoma is documented (search terms, fields, filters) and scoped to the PMC OA Subset.
Recall/precision measured against a documented seed set of known Ewing OA articles, with the numbers reported.
The query and evaluation are reproducible: committed query string + seed-set list + method.
